title: URL-list source settings

urls.description: Exactly the URLs to fetch, never following links; canonicalised by the admin on save.

ignoreQueryParams.description: Query parameters dropped by the canonicaliser in addition to the fixed tracking and session list.

directoryIndexNames.description: File names treated as the directory index (index.html), so /a/ and /a/index.html are one identity.

noiseSelectors.description: CSS selectors removed before the content hash (HTML noise normalisation, connectors design §12.2).

revalidateEvery.description: Every n-th run sends no validators, catching wrong 304s.

timeoutSeconds.description: Whole-request timeout in seconds; the HTML and file body limits of connectors design §4 still apply.

fetchMode.description: http: the HTTP response is the content. browser: every HTML page is rendered by headless Chromium in the renderer, every request it makes fetched by the worker (connectors design §8). A change starts a sync that fetches every page again.

readySelector.description: browser only: CSS naming the loaded content; the page is ready when it holds text and then no request has been open for Render:QuietPeriod. Null: ready when no request has been open for Render:QuietPeriod after load (connectors design §8.3). A change starts a sync that fetches every page again.

scrollToLoad.description: browser only: scroll to the bottom until the page stops growing (at most 10 steps) for content loaded on scroll. A change starts a sync that fetches every page again.

piiMode.description: What a personal-data flag does in a public collection: hold (the set is held until the document is cleared) or report (the set goes live and the flag is reported; a personnummer or samordningsnummer still holds). A change applies at each document's next swap.

description: Settings of a URL-list source (Sources.Settings; connectors design §4, §12.3). Each member's x-effect says what a change needs.
